title: Jeremiah 15
paragraphs: ¹ Then the Lord said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel stood before me pleading, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence; let them go! ² And when they ask, 'Where shall we go?' tell them: 'This is what the Lord says: Those destined for death — to death; those for the sword — to the sword; those for famine — to famine; those for captivity — to captivity.' ³ I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," declares the Lord, "the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the sky and the wild animals to devour and destroy. ⁴ I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem. ⁵ Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?

⁶ You have abandoned me," declares the Lord, "you keep turning back. So I will stretch out my hand against you and destroy you. I am tired of holding back. ⁷ I will winnow them with a threshing fork at the city gates of the land. I will bereave and destroy my people, for they have not changed their ways. ⁸ I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of young men; suddenly I will bring down on them anguish and terror. ⁹ The mother of seven will faint and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. I will put those who remain to the sword before their enemies," declares the Lord.

¹¹ The Lord said, "Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will make your enemies treat you well in times of disaster and distress. ¹² Can iron from the north be smashed, or bronze broken? ¹³ I will give your wealth and your treasures as plunder without charge — because of all your sins throughout your land. ¹⁴ I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you." ¹⁵ Lord, you understand; remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are long-suffering — do not take me away. Think of how I suffer reproach for your sake.

¹⁶ When your words came, I devoured them. Your words were my joy and the delight of my heart, for I bear your name, Lord God Almighty. ¹⁷ I never sat in the company of mockers, never made merry with them. I sat alone because your hand was on me, for you had filled me with indignation. ¹⁸ Why is my pain unending, my wound severe and refusing to heal? You are like a deceptive brook to me, like a spring that has dried up. ¹⁹ Therefore this is what the Lord says: "If you turn back, I will restore you so you can serve me. If you speak words that are worthy, not worthless, you will be my spokesman. Let these people turn to you, but you must not turn to them. ²⁰ I will make you a wall of bronze to this people; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to rescue and save you," declares the Lord.
²¹ "I will deliver you from the hands of the wicked and rescue you from the clutches of the ruthless."
